_edit: Edit each release: version is the release number (csproj <Version>), 2 to 4 items. title says what it is, how says where to click to try it now. icon is one of sparkles, armchair, activity, link, book-open, rocket, box, camera, git-compare (Lucide).

items.title: Analysis set
items.how: After Daylight or Area summary, tap Add to analysis set. Print analysis set prints them as their own PDF.

items.title: Interior and exterior render
items.how: Click a room's floor, then More actions → Interior render; or More actions → Exterior render. Pick north, east, south or west, then Confirm.

items.title: Render views in the view picker
items.how: Tap the cube at the top left: Interior and Exterior list your saved renders, one click shows one.
